stable.notes: An empty speaker review used to say "predates speaker review. Update the server". That named the one action that could not help: the count it reported has nothing to do with the server version. For a new user the real cause is that no voices are enrolled, which the system cannot fix by itself, and every speaker is correctly labelled Ext until one is. Both empty states now say what is actually wrong and name the fix: say "enroll my voice" on the glasses to record a 30-second sample.
